notes.title: weekly update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] MVP rankings now have an Assist collum (replaces Buffs/Debuffs).
[*] Akels Again Skill now also gives assist points.
[*] Unitinfo (history) now also counts the number of assists a unit has done (e.g. Akel Again Skill).
[*] Improved model setup and model loading time.
[*] Characters/Units can now be blocked from being deployed - for more story/mission possiblities (used chapter 21).
[*] Finished Raymond profile/dialogue artwork.
[*] Finished Akel profile/dialogue artwork.
[*] New event conditons for permament (recurring) events.
[*] Fixed one instance were attack all unit in range did not work properly during counter attacking.
[*] Fixed hp display error (wrong display) that occurred when attacking an enemy that deals aoe dmg.
[*] Fixed summon/spawn (flicker) unit animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update start of Chpater 22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The game now has small animations if tiles are changed (not use for all chapters at this point).
[*] Dmg (forecast) color changed back to normal - color change will return with more setting (better base color and visibility).
[*] Chapter 8 (boss) tiles now have effect animation if dealing dmg or healing a Unit.
[*] Added a new grafic/animation for Residue of Blik.
[*] Added a new grafic/animation for Residue of Decay 
[*] Consumable items in convoy now are all shown as usable (not grey text) during trading.
[*] Corrosion (enemey skill) has a new tooltip clarefing the adjacent part better.
[*] Tile hl are now hidden after movement or after target selection.
[*] Fixed: Summoned Units now will show stats (bottom menu dmg forecast - was only after frist move).
[*] Fixed: chapter 12 loading teleport grafics (final dialogue - was black).
[*] Fixed: Skills that do not end unit turn will not activate tile effect (e.g. asura akel on healing tiles).
[*] Fixed: admin model loading (ch13).
[/list]

notes.title: Small update + start of Chapter 21
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New dmg forecast number colors (diffrent colors for enemy and player).
[*] New Unit/model Nor.
[*] Complete Rework of Kailas Skilltree.
[*] 4 new Skills (kaila).
[*] 2 new Skills (nor).
[*] Added first part of chapter 21 (no gameplay).
[*] Fixed again condtions higher level (again was not usable on some units).
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Cleave now deals about 10% more damage to secondard targets on level 1 and 2.
[*] The game now remembers the last window location.
[*] Fixed gwens starting skill (wrong skill from new skill testing).
[*] Fixed some bugs and errors with graphic setting (reopening the game on not main monitor)
[*] last game window position is now saved.
[*] Fixed removed some unwanted animation delays on end turn animations (if unit dies during endturn).
[*] Fixed the game will open open the unit actionmenu (not unit assit menu), if player starts movment by clicking on an ally unit and unit has no skill that can be use on target unit.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 19 + 20 (early version)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added first version of chapter 19 and 20 (20 is pretty empty at this point - layout).
[*] Minimap now shows danger zones.
[*] Improved save game/save list loading time (only appies to new saves).
[*] Added 3 new Skills (Eydis).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused skill animation sound not beplayed if skill has no traget (boss attack no target).
[*] Fixed akel now has best attack stats after geting his weapon.
[*] Fixed a bug were enemey dangerzone was not correct (complex enviroments/tiles).
[*] Fixed a bug were during movement the moveline was not set to the fastes/best route.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix + Small Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Resedu (tile effects) now have Animations and Sounds.
[*] If a Thief leaves the map an info will open (thief has left message).
[*] Chapter 6 Thief will now exit the map (or try to), if the player loots the chest befor him.
[*] Battle saves now show the current turn for the save game.
[*] Fixed hp fikering bug for tile effect and healing.
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen during chapter 9, if all tiles next to Meliora ware blocked by units.
[*] Fixed a bug that happened after using rifts (teleports) some keybindings would not work untile opening mapmenu or ending turn.
[*] Fixed a bug that would display tile animations (rotation) wrong on the minimap.
[*] Fixed a bug that after (continuously) loading the (same) game, wrong music was playing
[*] Fixed stat boosters are now save and loaded (battle save).
[*] Fixed error/crash reporting - some error message were to long - they are now scaled to fit the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: hotfix: chapter 3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur if a battlesave in chapter 3 was loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Chapter 14+15 + balance/bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chapter 14 and 15 enemies now have better stats.
[*] Chapter 14 and 15 now has all events and can be played normally.
[*] Chapter 14 dialogue is finished but needs to be added.
[*] Chapter 15 dialogue are still unfinished (70% done).
[*] Added new skills to new Chapterer in Chapter 15.
[*] Added 2 new Items in Chapter 15.
[/list]

[h1]Skill changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Asura is now only useable if asura is not active on the Unit.
[*] If an enemy unit is entraped, all units of the enemy group will start to move (attack).
[*] Power Stance is now alot stronger (e.g. level 1 was +4 dmg and now is +8).
[*] Plasemar Burst now deals more damage but hit count has been reduced in return.
[*] New Skill (Gwen) Stun Piston (enemy unit is unable to counter attack if using Piston Punch).
[*] Spell Dancer (Meliora) now deals the dmg the traget would inflict if it would attack it self.
[*] Water Torrent Skill now has unit movement (unit attacking animation).
[/list]

[h1]Menu and QoL:[/h1]
[list]
[*] keybinds help now shows a device icon for the keybindings.
[*] Battle prep force deploy unit are shown first.
[*] Change the basic option for warnings - show warning for all skills is not die default anymore.
[*] You can now see what items will be rewarded at the end of an mission (bonus display).
[/list]

[h1]Bugs and Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed: good footing (Road buff) now shows the buff indicator.
[*] fixed: Spirit Engergy (Spirti Grass) now shows the buff indicator.
[*] fixed: Removed the small black border at the bottom of the minimap (only effected some maps).
[*] fixed: chapter 13 concentrade life (second spawn) animation and tooltip are remove after effect is used up.
[*] fixed: a bug were the second wave of the lich boss fight would sometimes not spawn.
[*] fixed: a bug were a recently killed unit would still do endturn aura effects.
[*] fixed: a bug were aura buffs would still be active after swaping unit during battle preperation.
[*] fixed: a gamecrash related to game event loading (battle save).
[*] fixed: a crash that could happen during chapter 13 the moment phase 2 started.
[*] fixed: a bug were resorce cost was not calculated corretly if counter attacking.
[*] fixed: if window size is changed the keybinding display is also resized.
[*] fixed: a bug were auras would not be removed for the tile the unit was stating during battle perp (after unit is/was removed).
[/list]
